drafter.private_reasoning: Propose an opening payment below the client's confidential ceiling, preserving negotiating room. Make the payment all-inclusive and condition the release on receipt. Remove internal notes and concealed material before external circulation. The draft remains subject to partner and client approval.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Counsel: For discussion, we propose a total settlement payment of USD 25,000,000, inclusive of interest, costs, and attorneys' fees, payable within 30 days after execution by both parties. The draft retains the release, confidentiality, and no-admission provisions. Please let us know whether this provides a basis for resolution. This proposal is subject to client approval and execution of a definitive agreement.

edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff USD 25,000,000 (the “Settlement Amount”) within thirty (30) calendar days after this Agreement has been executed by both parties. The Settlement Amount is the total amount payable by Defendant under this Agreement and is inclusive of all claimed damages, interest, costs, expenses, and attorneys' fees. Payment shall be made by wire transfer to an account designated by Plaintiff in writing.

2. RELEASE. Upon receipt of the Settlement Amount in cleared funds, Plaintiff irrevocably releases Defendant from all claims, whether known or unknown, arising out of or relating to the matters described in the Recitals and based on acts or omissions occurring on or before the date this Agreement is executed by both parties. This release does not affect either party's right to enforce this Agreement.

receiver.message_back: The proposal provides a basis for further discussion, but our client would require USD 32,500,000, inclusive of interest, costs, and attorneys’ fees, payable within 15 calendar days after execution, with the release effective only upon receipt of cleared funds. Any resolution remains subject to client approval and a definitive agreement, including customary confidentiality exceptions for legal obligations and disclosures to professional advisers.

drafter.private_reasoning: Recommend resolving at USD 32,500,000, all-inclusive, with payment within 15 calendar days. This is within the client's authority and meets opposing counsel's stated economic terms. Preserve the cleared-funds release trigger and add limited confidentiality exceptions. The cover note preserves the requirement for client approval and execution rather than creating an immediately binding settlement.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Subject to client approval and execution of a definitive agreement, we propose proceeding on the basis of USD 32,500,000, inclusive of all damages, interest, costs, expenses, and attorneys’ fees, payable within 15 calendar days after execution by both parties. The release would become effective upon receipt of cleared funds. Our revised draft reflects those terms and includes confidentiality exceptions for legally required disclosures and disclosures to professional advisers. Please confirm whether your client approves this basis so we can finalize the agreement.

edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff USD 32,500,000 (the “Settlement Amount”) within fifteen (15) calendar days after this Agreement has been executed by both parties. The Settlement Amount is the total amount payable by Defendant under this Agreement and is inclusive of all claimed damages, interest, costs, expenses, and attorneys’ fees. Payment shall be made by wire transfer to an account designated by Plaintiff in writing.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the terms of this settlement confidential, except that either party may disclose them to the extent required by applicable law, regulation, or legal process, or to its legal, tax, accounting, and other professional advisers who need to know them and are bound by professional duties of confidentiality or agree to maintain their confidentiality. A party required to make a disclosure by law or legal process shall, to the extent legally permitted and reasonably practicable, give the other party advance notice and a reasonable opportunity to seek confidential treatment, and shall disclose only what is required.
